turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on word order (subject + verb + object)?
turns.tutor:
Example: eats / Anna / rice / at noon. Who goes first, then the action, then the thing, then the time: Anna eats rice at noon.
Rule: put who first, then the action, then the thing; place or time goes last.
Right: Tom paints pictures. Wrong: Paints Tom pictures.
Now you try. Put in order: "plays / Sam / chess / on Mondays"
